:::{#def-pmf}
#### Probability mass function (PMF)

If $X$ is a [discrete random variable](#def-discrete-rv),
the **probability mass function** of $X$ at value $x$,
denoted $f(x)$, $f_X(x)$, $\P(x)$, $\P_X(x)$, or $\P(X=x)$,
is the probability that $X$ takes exactly the value $x$
[@wikipedia_probability_mass_function]:

$$\P(X=x) \eqdef \Pr(\{X=x\})$$

:::
